 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Things are going from bad to worse for Bayern. After Saibari had already gone off injured, another star has now been sidelined.
 This time it was Serge Gnabry. Around 30 minutes in, the Germany international needed treatment on his left foot.
 He was unable to continue either. Josip Stanisic came on for Gnabry.
 Let's hope neither player's injury is serious.
